questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Enterobius vermicularis?
options: Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Eggs on perianal adhesive-tape specimens; routine stool testing is less sensitive.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
questions.explanation: Eggs on perianal adhesive-tape specimens; routine stool testing is less sensitive. Perianal tape microscopy, commonly using morning specimens collected before washing or defecation under local laboratory guidance; 100–400×.
